official_definition: Flash - [Card Slash] Discard one "Rookie/Champion/Ultimate/Mega" Spirit card from your Hand. Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with BP equal inferior to the [LV1] BP of the discarded card.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Card Slash] or [Card Slash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Card Slash]", "give [Card Slash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
